prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: consistency correction to an existing two-view mecha head reference sheet.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: left true front view, right front three-quarter view of ONE helmet.

The user accepts the current design and the straight aft-facing TEMPLE antennas. Preserve them completely. The only remaining correction is that the CENTRAL TOP CREST / head-top antenna does not describe the same structure in the two views. Change only this central ivory-and-ochre crest, primarily in the RIGHT three-quarter view. Use the LEFT FRONT crest as the design authority. This is a projection-consistency repair, not a redesign.

Lock ONE shared crest construction:
- A single integrated LOW longitudinal crest assembly sits on the helmet's central sagittal line, running from the forehead toward the back of the skull. It is attached closely along the helmet surface, not a free-standing horn.
- Two equal ivory banks on the left and right of this ONE assembly frame a narrow solid ochre-gold inlaid center channel. The gold is a solid recessed insert, NOT an open hole or a fork. Both ivory banks are the same physical length, thickness, curvature and end shape.
- The LONG upper gold inlay tapers into the broad ivory forehead saddle. The SHORT lower rectangular ochre insert is a separate detail in that same saddle; a clear ivory bridge separates the two gold inserts.
- Both banks follow the same rearward curve and terminate together at ONE shared rear station with matched rounded/chamfered caps. Do not make one rail taller, longer, or more curved. Do not split the top into two independent prongs, a V, two splayed horns, or extra stacked blades.
- Match the same visible armor segment boundaries, crest width relative to helmet, long-inlay/white-bridge/short-insert ordering and mounting position in both views. In the right view only perspective foreshortening and occlusion change. The far bank is partly hidden as appropriate. Do not expose a different open fork, a new gold shape, or an extra crest component.
Keep the LEFT front-view crest essentially unchanged, including its bilateral symmetry; only the smallest necessary cap clarification is allowed. Repair the RIGHT crest so it is clearly the exact left crest rotated with the same head.

KEEP ALL OTHER PIXELS/FEATURES AS CLOSE AS POSSIBLE TO THE INPUT: accepted paired straight rearward temple antennas, round temple hubs, teal helmet shell plates, forehead outline and visor, smooth closed ivory face mask, cheek armor, neck, collar, shoulders, existing teal/ivory/ochre/amber palette, ink/cel shading, same camera angles and relative sizes, and the exact two-bust landscape composition. In particular do not bend or flare the accepted side antennas again and do not change the face or central-crest identity. Transparent background preserved, no text, arrows, labels, inset or third view.
